proved_here.lemma_A_2cycle: s_T(id_n)=rev_n, s_T(rev_n)=id_n for both maps, all n (proof in SUMMARY.md; verified n<=10).
proved_here.lemma_B_reversal_tightness: If pi avoids T union T^r then {pi, pi^r} is a 2-cycle; and Av_n({132,213,231,312}) = {id_n, rev_n}; hence the pure-reversal mechanism yields no periodic points beyond {id,rev}.
proved_here.lemma_C_last_element: (s_T(pi))_n = pi_1 for both maps, all n (verified S_3..S_7).
proved_here.theorem_D_finite_certification: All orbits of both maps on S_n hit {id,rev} within B(n) for n<=10: 132_213: 3,4,7,7,12,13,18,21; 231_213: exactly n-1. Certificate logic in SUMMARY.md. Full sweeps, zero flags, CAP=200.
proved_here.theorem_E_reduction: Conjecture 5.1 is equivalent to the Attractor Lemma (every orbit reaches {id_n,rev_n}). The open content is exactly that lemma.
proved_here.push_blocking_conditions: Exact blocked-push conditions derived and verified for both maps; Theorem 2.3 clumping recurrence verified against direct simulation on all of S_6 for both maps; complement conjugation s_{c(T)}=c s_T c holds; reverse conjugation s_{T^r}=r s_T r is FALSE (falsified S_5).
